Title: Remediation commit is outside immutable v1.0.4 tag
Evidence: main/package remain 1.0.4 at d2aba281, tag v1.0.4 resolves to 9606c767
Impact: New fixes cannot be qualified or published as v1.0.4
Recommended fix: Bump to >=1.0.5 and create a new immutable tag

Title: Publication staging misses parent directories
Evidence: Manifest includes win-unpacked/MiniMaxAssetTool.exe; stager creates only publication root
Impact: copyFileSync fails ENOENT and publication cannot complete
Recommended fix: mkdir destination parent recursively before every copy

Title: All critical coverage files are waived
Evidence: 16/16 critical files have waivers; 5-point tolerance; aggregate floors 50/60/30
Recommended fix: Use narrow branch/line waivers with expiry and substitute evidence

Title: Installer has circular trust anchor
Evidence: CMD, key, verifier, signature and payload come from same untrusted folder
Recommended fix: Use signed installer with embedded trusted key

Title: Publication does not verify Minisign cryptographically
Evidence: Only .minisig existence and manifest hashes are checked
Impact: Replaced manifest/files/fake signature can be staged
Recommended fix: Verify signature with independent pinned trust anchor

Title: Provider kind bypasses production custom-URL block
Evidence: Arbitrary provider can use kind=openrouter plus attacker baseUrl
Impact: Stored Bearer key can be sent to attacker-controlled host

Title: Clean VM installs global Node and performs shallow smoke
Evidence: setup-node is used; probe checks only bridge/DOM/sandbox
Impact: No proof release works without Node or local runtime paths work
Recommended fix: Run node-free harness and real offline functions

Title: Acceptance rejects valid unsplit archive
Impact: Small valid releases cannot pass qualification
Recommended fix: Reuse archiveFiles and test both forms

Title: Upgrade and interrupt tests do not prove migration/rollback
Evidence: Same version reinstalled; fixed 10s kill may miss critical phase
Impact: Real upgrades and rollback can remain broken
Recommended fix: Test old-to-new release and deterministic fault injection

Title: Mutation score covers only 16 directed mutants
Evidence: Hard-coded mutations omit many critical modules

Title: Download instructions omit mandatory signature files
Evidence: README/release notes omit minisig, pubkey and verifier
Recommended fix: List every required file and align optional/mandatory wording

Title: Root minisign.exe not Authenticode-gated
Evidence: Verifier checks app tree, not published root verifier
Impact: A shipped executable is outside claimed all-PE gate
Recommended fix: Check every PE in final publication inventory

Title: Unsigned manual dry-run is internally impossible
Evidence: Finalizer and stager require key/signature even on manual dispatch
Recommended fix: Conditionally skip signed-only stages or remove promise

Title: SBOM package hash may belong to wrong duplicate version
Evidence: Package JSON resolution uses name, not name@version path
Impact: Hash/license metadata can mismatch component version

Title: Publication accepts extra manifest entries
Evidence: Canonical check is subset-only and paths are not constrained
Recommended fix: Require exact set equality and safe relative paths
